title: Special Topics in Historic Preservation; Preservation Toolkit for Cultural Heritage
description: This PALS course will create a toolkit to support community groups who want to capture the history and culture of their community. Fall 2026 will work with Lyttonsville, MD, a neighborhood of residential and lightindustrial buildings inside the Beltway along the planned Purple Line. This course is a partnership between the Historic Preservation Program, the Purple Line Corridor Coalition, and the National Center forSmart Growth.
